task_completion.description: Navigate to the Recruitment or Job Positions dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Odoo Recruitment dashboard or a list view of Job Positions.

task_completion.description: Locate and open the 'Experienced Developer' job position to initiate the cloning/duplication process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the configuration form for 'Experienced Developer' or the selection of this specific record.

task_completion.description: Trigger the 'Duplicate' or 'Copy' action from the Action menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Action' dropdown menu open with 'Duplicate' selected, or a new record form appearing with ' (copy)' in the title.

task_completion.description: Rename the new job position to 'Senior Python Developer'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text input field for Job Position title contains 'Senior Python Developer'.

task_completion.description: Assign the job position to the 'R&D USA' department.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Department' field in the form shows 'R&D USA' selected.

task_completion.description: Set the 'Expected New Employees' (Recruitment Target) to 2.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The numerical field for 'Expected New Employees' or 'Target' shows the value 2.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface rather than executing database queries or scripts via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on Odoo buttons, and text entry into web forms.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply navigate to a pre-existing 'Senior Python Developer' record if it already existed, but actually performed the duplication/creation steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the transition from the 'Experienced Developer' form to a new record creation via the Duplicate action.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live Odoo instance and not a static mockup.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL bar shows a consistent Odoo domain/IP and the UI responds dynamically to clicks (e.g., dropdowns opening, loading spinners).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source job to be cloned is 'Experienced Developer'. The new job must be named 'Senior Python Developer'. The department must be set to 'R&D USA' and the 'Expected New Employees' field must be exactly 2. Ensure the agent uses the 'Duplicate' feature in Odoo to 'clone' the position as requested.
